title: Spaces
body: A colour, an icon and an order for each Space. Swipe between them, or make a new one in a single step.

title: A real profile per Space
body: Own logins, history and passwords for each Space. A new profile takes one step.

title: Import from Arc
body: Spaces, pinned tabs, folders, Favorites and logins, imported on your Mac.

title: Command bar
body: ⌘T opens one box for tabs, Spaces, sites and actions. ⌘L edits the address.

title: Pinned tabs, folders and drag
body: Drag to pin and move, ⌥ to copy, ⌘-click to select several rows and act on them together.

title: Favorites
body: Saved apps that go back to their address in one click.

title: Split View
body: Two or three panes side by side, each with its own profile. Drag a pane out to make it a tab again.

title: Peek
body: Links from pinned tabs open in a card over your page. Promote it to a tab, or to a split.

title: Air Traffic Control and Little Arc
body: Links from other apps go to the right Space, already signed in, or open in a small window of their own.

title: Auto-archive and Library
body: Today's tabs archive on a timer you choose, and stay searchable in the Library.

title: Full screen
body: The sidebar, the traffic lights and the Esc-twice exit all behave the way they do in Arc.

title: Picture in picture
body: Video and calls keep playing in a small window when you switch away.

title: Chrome extensions
body: Install from the Chrome Web Store. Each one is reviewed, and added per profile.

title: Permissions and dialogs
body: Camera, location, password and sign-in prompts appear in Airc's own cards, over the right page.

title: Light on memory
body: Hidden tabs unload. Tabs with typed text, and tabs in a call, stay.
